page: Microsoft Azure M208ms_v2 is an x86_64 memory-optimized server belonging to the MSv2 family. It is powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8280L processors running at 2.7 GHz, delivering 208 vCPUs across 104 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The processor features a 105 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and AVX512_VNNI. The server is equipped with an exceptionally large memory capacity of 5700.0 GB, providing approximately 27.4 GB of RAM per core, and includes 4194 GB of local SSD storage. It is premium storage capable and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

Benchmark data reveals a stark contrast between single-core and multi-core performance. While single-core metrics are relatively weak, placing in the bottom 25% for stress-ng and Geekbench, the massive core count drives multi-core performance into the top 10% tier, as demonstrated by a stress-ng multi-core score of 187,912.86 and a bzip3 multi-threaded decompression speed of 596.36 GB/sec. Memory performance is highly optimized for cached operations, with small-block read-only memory bandwidth reaching a top-tier 10,453.04 GB/sec, though uncached large-block read and write speeds drop to a strong but lower tier. Database operations are highly efficient, highlighted by top-tier Redis SET performance of 149.33 million operations per second.

Given its massive resource footprint, the M208ms_v2 represents a high-density hardware class designed for scale rather than budget efficiency. The primary tradeoff is its lower single-threaded performance, meaning workloads must be highly parallelized to justify the resource allocation. This server is best suited for memory-intensive enterprise applications, large-scale relational databases, in-memory data stores like Redis, heavy multi-threaded data processing, and large-scale virtualization workloads.
description: The Microsoft Azure M208ms_v2 is a highly specialized, memory-intensive server from the MSv2 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 208 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8280L processors at 2.7 GHz, paired with an extensive 5700.0 GB of RAM and 4194 GB of local SSD storage. While single-core CPU and memory benchmarks fall into the lower tiers, its massive parallel processing capabilities deliver top-tier multi-core performance and exceptional cached memory bandwidth of over 10,453 GB/sec. This resource density makes it highly capable for massive database operations, as evidenced by top-tier Redis SET performance. The M208ms_v2 is qualitatively positioned as a premium, high-density solution for enterprise workloads, making it best suited for large in-memory databases, heavy multi-threaded data processing, and memory-bound enterprise applications.
